messages:
Maya (support): FYI customer ACME reported p95->p99 jump for Dedicated pool during their billing window, started ~02:15 UTC. They saw a mix of 504s and 500s and long tail latency. I collected traces and a live debug capture.
Maya (support): Quick summary: p99 spiked to ~12s, errors 5xx ~1.8% for a ~30min window. Customer says it aligned with invoice cycle traffic burst.
Arjun (eng-sre): Can you paste the attach/scale logs? suspect scale-up queue backlog or cold GPU attach.
Maya (support): Pasting sanitized snippets: ```
[2026-03-16T02:14:03Z] scale-controller: enqueue attach request pool=dedicated-acme-priority id=txn-9f3
[2026-03-16T02:14:05Z] provisioner: pulling image ai-runtime:v3.2
[2026-03-16T02:14:35Z] nodepool: ImagePullBackOff: rpc timeout
[2026-03-16T02:14:40Z] attach: auth: token validation ratelimit hit user=acme-org
[2026-03-16T02:15:12Z] scale-controller: attach timeout 30s, retrying
```
Maya (support): Also saw bursts of auth 429s in the customer logs at the same time.
Priya (eng-oncall): Interesting. We had a rate limiter config change yesterday for token introspection to protect control plane. Could be tripping during invoice churn.
Arjun (eng-sre): Two interacting failure modes here: 1) image pull backoffs slowed instance warmup, 2) auth introspect rate limiting caused attach to fail/retry which kept requests stuck in scale-queue. Net = deadlock where scale controller keeps retrying but nodes never attach fast enough, queue piles up -> p99 spike.
Elena (support-lead): Customer needs immediate mitigation. Can we do temporary handoff to hosted models or bump min-pool for them?
Arjun (eng-sre): Immediate options: a) increase dedicated min_pool for acme to 3 (was 0) b) bump attach timeout and backoff parameters c) temporarily whitelist ACME in auth-introspect RB to avoid 429s d) pre-pull images on startup nodes to avoid ImagePullBackOff.
Priya (eng-oncall): I can restart the scale-controller to clear any stuck state but that won’t fix image pulls or auth throttling. Suggest combo: restart controller + bump min_pool.
DeployBot: deploy/status: scale-controller v2.14 rollback queued by @Priya at 02:22 UTC (dry-run)
Arjun (eng-sre): Config snippet we applied for immediate mitigation:
```yaml
autoscale:
  dedicated:
    pools:
      acme-priority:
        min_instances: 3
        attach_timeout_seconds: 60
        concurrent_attach_limit: 8
```
Arjun (eng-sre): Also increased auth-introspect quota for acme service token from 100/s -> 500/s for 10m window.
Maya (support): Actioned those at 02:22 UTC; customer reported p99 improved to ~1.2s within ~6 minutes. They still saw a few 5xx but much lower. :thumbsup:
Priya (eng-oncall): I restarted scale-controller and watched backlog drain. Attaches still had a few ImagePullBackOffs — we set a pre-pull job for the pool image and it cleared.
Elena (support-lead): Customer confirmed recovery at 02:29 UTC and will monitor the rest of the billing window. Thanks team.
Arjun (eng-sre): Short postmortem notes / proposed permanent fixes: 1) add preemptive warmup policy for billing window customers (schedule pre-warm to min_instances N before invoice cycle) 2) adjust fairshare scheduler to not starve priority pools during global churn 3) implement adaptive auth-introspect backoff with burst capacity for known high-QPS customers 4) cache/persist images on hot nodes & increase image pull parallelism on provisioner.
Priya (eng-oncall): I'll file follow-ups and owners: SRE -> arjun to own warmup + pre-pull infra, Platform -> priya to validate fairshare changes, Sec -> create safe exception flow for auth introspect bursts (elena to coordinate).
Maya (support): Customer wants a playbook so they can avoid hitting this in future. I'll draft runbook steps: pre-warm, traffic shaping, and a support escalation channel.
Elena (support-lead): Good. Also add alerting tweak: detect combined signals (attach queue > 50 AND imagepull errors > 5% AND auth 429>threshold) -> high-severity page.
Arjun (eng-sre): Note for follow-up PRs: respect max_concurrent_image_pulls, retry jitter, and increase default attach timeout to 45s.
Priya (eng-oncall): Closing this thread for now, will reopen if customer sees reoccurence. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
